name: Accessibility Review
description: Review components for accessibility compliance when UI components are modified

actions.prompt:
Review the React components for WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance. Check for:
1. Proper semantic HTML usage
2. ARIA labels and roles
3. Keyboard navigation support
4. Color contrast ratios
5. Focus management
6. Screen reader compatibility
7. Alternative text for images
8. Form label associations

Provide specific recommendations for improvements.
